A plant that smells spicy and tastes exactly as it smells. Besides increasing one's appetite, it also removes excess dampness from your system and relieves pain.
A fungus with a unique aroma, unremarkable in appearance but highly nutritious. Warning: some fungi may be poisonous!
A juicy, sour-but-sweet plant. The debate on whether it's a vegetable or a fruit is still ongoing. We may have to refer to the tax laws for the answer…
A plant that has countless layers. "I'd peel off your layers one by one, just so I can reach your heart hidden inside"… How does that pickup line sound?

A sturdy plant that's cheap, easy to grow and, most importantly, delicious no matter how you cook it. A truly friendly ingredient for kitchen novices!
A crispy, sweet fruit with an ordinary appearance and taste. It may be somewhat boring, but it's also nostalgia-inducing.
A sweet, delicious fruit without skin or a core. Can be eaten whole after just a bit of washing. This epitome of perfection tastes just like childhood!
A fruit with abundant sour-but-sweet juice that flows out the moment it's cut open. A true summery delight!

A fruit covered in bristles, hard on the outside but soft inside, containing the sweetest juice. Makes you wonder what it must have been through in its life to have developed such a thick shell… poor thing.

A freshwater fish that is delicious but also surprisingly dangerous due to the tiny, soft bones hiding in the delicate flesh. If you allow them to escape your tongue's pursuit and stab into your throat, it'll be a true nightmare!

In the unnoticed cracks of walls dwells an anomaly called "Peepy." It has no complete form, and no one can even describe its outline. All witnesses can confirm is a single eye hiding behind the wall cracks. Peepy is obsessed with observing the minutiae of human life: steam rising from breakfast stalls, lovers' hesitant fingertips under streetlights, drunkards mumbling profanities at trash cans… All these vivid moments of life give it a kind of warm, tingling sensation. Unfortunately, this careful voyeurism is always perceived as an intrusion, followed by screams and angry shouts. Now… Peepy has gotten smarter. It has collected a pile of sunglasses, convinced they're the perfect disguise, fantasizing that it's wearing them and boldly blending into the bustling crowds.

Ingredients:
3 eggs, 35g corn oil, 40g milk, 50g cake flour, 30g granulated sugar, half a lemon
Instructions:
1. Separate egg whites and yolks into two bowls.
2. In a new bowl, add 35g corn oil and 40g milk, whisk until yogurt-like consistency.
3. Add egg yolks and cake flour, mix until smooth.
4. Take egg whites from refrigerator, add lemon juice, gradually add sugar in three portions and whip thoroughly.
5. Take 1/3 of the meringue and fold into the egg yolk mixture until evenly combined.
6. Pour the mixed cake batter into the meringue bowl and fold until evenly combined.
7. Pour cake batter into mold, use a toothpick to pop surface bubbles.
8. Bake in oven at 150°C for 60 minutes.
